- Proposed windows (PT): Option A: Thu, May 6 — 09:00–11:00; Option B: Fri, May 7 — 14:00–16:00.

Attachments: intake-form.pdf (customer to fill), draft-agenda.xlsx (current draft). Can you take point on ops staffing and runbook? Stephanie — would you lead the Day 0 host run? Priyom — can you own bridge and collab doc? Marissa — CS/pm for post-launch ops and success metrics.
